title: Audit sidecar
description: One <artifact>.qa.json sits beside each artifact. Adapted from folio-assistant's block-qa/v1. Entries are append-only and are NOT deduplicated: script, agent and human verdicts co-exist. The current verdict for a criterion is the most recent entry whose fieldHash matches the present sources; if none matches, the criterion is stale and needs re-auditing, which is the design working rather than a fault. The trail is a by-product of doing the work, not written up afterwards.

artifact.description: Path to the artifact this sidecar describes.

sources.description: The inputs the artifact derives from, by role. Keys are stable names such as bpmn, dictionary, skill.

sourceHashes.description: Twelve-character SHA-256 prefixes of the sources at the time of the most recent write.

criteria.description: Keyed by requirement statement key or checker-defined criterion id. Each value is the append-only list of verdicts for that criterion, oldest first.

reviewer.description: Who produced this verdict. The three kinds are not interchangeable and the record must not blur them.

kind.description: script: a deterministic checker, reproducible. agent: model-driven, not deterministic. human: final authority.

id.description: Script path, agent skill id, or user login.

scriptHash.description: SHA-256 prefix of the checker's own source at audit time. A mismatch means the checker's logic changed, so its past verdicts have expired too.

scriptCommit.description: Full commit SHA of the last change to the checker. Audit trail only.

model.description: Model id, when kind is agent.

skill.description: Skill id the reviewer ran under.

then.description: An agent verdict without a model id cannot be reproduced or discounted later.

fieldHash.description: Source hashes at the moment of this verdict. This is what pins the verdict: edit a source and every verdict derived from it goes stale on its own, with no bookkeeping.

evidence.description: Required on a failing verdict. A failure that cannot point at anything is itself a defect.

location.description: file:line, a spreadsheet cell, or an element id.

metrics.description: Checker-defined counts. Worth recording even on a pass: a clean run with implausible numbers is the failure mode these controls exist for.

fidelity.notes: Lane persona does not resolve. Flagged to l2-authors rather than mapped by guess. Fidelity remains a human ruling.
